title: Bin-Packing the Scheduler: 38% Fewer Nodes Without Pager Noise
abstract: We replaced the default Kubernetes scheduler scoring with a bin-packing plugin across 14 clusters. Cluster cost fell 38% but p99 deploy latency doubled in one region; we trace that to a capacity cliff in autoscaling and show the three metrics that caught it. Attendees leave with the plugin config, the observability queries, and a rollback checklist.

title: Cluster Autoscaling Lessons from Three Outages
abstract: A retelling of three autoscaling outages: what the cluster did, what the dashboards showed, and which capacity assumptions were wrong. Includes the measured latency before and after each fix.

title: Agents Will Change Everything
abstract: Agents are the future of software. In this talk I will share my vision of how model-driven agents will transform every industry and why you should be excited.

title: Retrieval Evaluation Beyond Eyeballing
abstract: We built an evaluation dataset of 900 labelled queries for our retrieval pipeline and compared three embedding models against a keyword baseline. Two fine-tuning attempts made recall worse; we explain why and show the dataset format so the audience can build their own.

title: Evaluating Retrieval the Boring Way, Part Two
abstract: A follow-up to last year's talk: we extend the retrieval evaluation dataset to 900 labelled queries, compare embedding models against a keyword baseline, and report the fine-tuning runs that made recall worse.

title: Accessible Components Under a 40 KB Bundle Budget
abstract: Live demo: we rebuild a data-grid component with keyboard navigation and screen-reader semantics, then measure the browser rendering cost and bundle size at each step. The trade-off between virtualised rows and native semantics gets an honest accounting.

title: Supply Chain Threats Nobody Audits
abstract: A tour of supply chain vulnerability classes. I will discuss secrets in build logs and why authentication tokens leak, and give general advice for your next incident.

title: Observability Budgets for Deploy Pipelines
abstract: How we cut deploy pipeline telemetry cost by 60% while keeping the traces needed to debug a failed rollout. Covers sampling decisions, one incident where sampling hid a regression, and the dashboards operators should keep.
